# Oakridge Veterinary Clinic

> > Full-service veterinary clinic in San Jose, California specializing in exotic pets, reptiles, amphibians, birds, and traditional companion animals with USDA-certified health certificates.

Oakridge Veterinary Clinic serves the Silicon Valley area with comprehensive veterinary care led by Dr. Boyd and Andreas Duvall. The clinic offers specialized exotic animal veterinary services alongside traditional pet healthcare, preventive care, dental services, and spay/neuter procedures.
